description: Away side scores first and then sits deep. Home turn up the pressure after the hour, turn it around with two late goals, and the finish gets frantic.

phases.label: away_low_block
phases.description: Away side protect their lead by dropping deep and ceding the ball.

phases.label: home_press_surge
phases.description: Home raise their line and press high; territory and shots swing their way.

phases.label: frantic_finish
phases.description: Both sides trade blows in a stretched, error-prone finish.

scripted_goals.description: Away take an early lead against the run of play.
